claim: Android's real DocumentsUI SAF journey imports every document the user selects and keeps every source a preview does not own: a preview refresh, a failed preview or a failed registration no longer removes a descriptor an import registered and is about to read.

verification.detail: All seven required jobs and the release gate passed. The Android job built the case APKs, booted an API 36 x86_64 emulator and ran the SAF preview journey: three documents selected through DocumentsUI are all imported (the failure this replaces imported two), the folder children import, and the descriptor-count assertions around a partial open, a revoked grant and a failed registration all hold.

limitations: Android evidence is from an API 36 x86_64 SwiftShader emulator, not a physical device.

The defect this replaces was intermittent: the same tree passed at b564479 and failed at c8316ba, so one green run is not proof of stability. A repeat run at b3f37da is recorded separately when it completes.
The guard for the invariant is a source check (scripts/test_android_registration_epoch.py and scripts/test_android_jni_bridge.py), because the behaviour needs a device.
Two FFI exports remain dead -- or_viewer_advance_generation and or_viewer_publish_rgba are defined in Rust and referenced nowhere -- recorded rather than deleted.
The local Android lane on this workstation reaches 33 journey stages with zero SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE but cannot write a verdict under memory contention, so it is not evidence.
